_comment: The sealed shelf, taken from the 'Restricted Titles' sheet of the College's
own register rather than chosen here. The reasons are the librarians' own
words. scripts/import-library.mjs reads this file and sets `restricted` in
the frontmatter it writes, so re-running the import does not unseal them.
THIS IS LORE, NOT ACCESS CONTROL. Every title below is a published Bethesda
book that anyone can read anywhere; sealing it here is a game the catalogue
plays, and the resolve endpoint says so in as many words. Nothing may be
added to this list that would matter if it leaked.
Three titles on the register are absent from the corpus and are listed here
anyway, so the two lists can be compared: 'Liminal Bridges: Simplified' is a
College self-publication, and 'Mannimarco, King of Worms' and 'The Doors of
Oblivion' are Oblivion-era books that the Skyrim-only source does not carry.
The importer reports them as unmatched rather than failing.

titles.A Kiss, Sweet Mother: A direct guide for how to perform the Black Sacrament to summon the Dark Brotherhood.
titles.A Tragedy in Black: Casualizes the practical elements of Daedric summoning and black soul gems.
titles.Brothers of Darkness: A primer on active, illegal assassin guilds and their devotion to Sithis and the Night Mother.
titles.Liminal Bridges: Effectively an instruction manual for opening Oblivion Gates.
titles.Liminal Bridges: Simplified: A simplified explanation of Liminal Bridges by Byrnolf Skjeld.
titles.Mannimarco, King of Worms: Romanticizes one of Tamriel's most catastrophic powers.
titles.Souls, Black and White: Detailed information on how sentient souls are trapped; bordering on actionable necromancy.
titles.The Doors of Oblivion: Held on the register as a sealed title.
